attribution.note: Marcus makes the assertion in his own voice; it is not part of the preceding quotation.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the firm assertion about available arguments and the hedged concession about particular arguments. The concession is not separately scored.

contract.note: Assessing whether defensible arguments establish negligible overall extinction risk is an ordinary reading in this context. The claim concerns arguments available at publication; the calendar-year boundary should not exclude earlier arguments still relevant then.

evidence.note: A contemporaneously available report relevant to the debate. Its 2022 findings establish disagreement, not whether any negligible-risk argument is sound.
A contemporaneous skeptical argument addressing a particular mechanism under explicit assumptions. It retains possible catastrophes and does not establish negligible overall extinction risk.

reviews.rationale: The packet neither comprehensively evaluates relevant arguments nor supplies a defensible argument establishing zero or negligible overall extinction risk. Disagreement and criticism of one mechanism cannot settle Marcus's universal assertion. The hedged concession does not make the separate firm assertion unscorable.
